name: NSKFDC Mahila Samridhi & Micro Credit Yojana
description: Special micro-credit & self-employment scheme by NSKFDC (Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment) providing loans up to ₹5 Lakh at a highly concessional 4% interest rate with 35% capital subsidy for Safai Karamcharis, Waste Pickers & their dependents.
nodalAgency: National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation (NSKFDC), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
targetAudience: Safai Karamcharis, Manual Scavengers, Waste Pickers and their dependents setting up rural micro-units
requiredDocuments: Safai Karamchari / Waste Picker Identification Certificate or Local Authority Verification
